# Bad Grammy's Creations

> Bad Grammy's Creations makes one-of-a-kind custom embroidery and personalized gifts in Northeast Ohio, from memory keepsake bears and Christmas stockings to monogrammed apparel, bags, pillows and more. If you can picture it, we can create it.

## Business facts

## Common questions
- How do I place an order? The easiest way is to message us on Facebook or call (330) 472-8946. Tell us what you're thinking and we'll take it from there. There's no online checkout, just a real conversation about your custom piece.
- How do memory keepsake bears work? You send us a loved one's clothing (a flannel, a favorite shirt, a jersey) and we hand-sew it into a keepsake bear or animal. We'll talk through which garments work best and what details you'd like, like a name or date embroidered on the foot.
- Can you make something that isn’t shown on the site? Absolutely. Custom is what we do best. If you can picture it, we can usually create it. Just reach out and describe your idea.
- How long does a custom piece take? It depends on the project and the season (the holidays book up fast). Reach out as early as you can and we’ll give you a realistic timeline for your piece.
- Where are you located? We're a home-based maker in Northeast Ohio and a regular at local craft fairs. Orders are handled directly by phone or Facebook message.
